checkpoints.description: [1/2] Review the last 69 pushes: keep the hygiene scan out of ignored siblings of a re-included file

impact_assessment.why: The wildcard .gitignore support keeps a directory walkable when it re-includes one .py file, but scan_tree then walks every ignored sibling too; an ignored reports/drop.py with a violation fails a clean hygiene scan.
impact_assessment.benefits: The hygiene scan visits only the re-included tracked file inside an ignored directory, matching the discovery walker and ADR-361.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: project hygiene walk; dependency: update_knowledge_base gitignore helpers; concurrency: none; state: check_project_hygiene.py, update_knowledge_base.py, tests, ADR, map
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first kept-sibling test, existing discovery and hygiene tests, unit tier, root scan, reachability and secret gates
